pub type Raw
pub enum UserReplaceOutcome
  Applied
  Conflict
  Forbidden
  Unavailable
  pub const ALL: [Self; 4]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum ConfigObservationOutcome
  Snapshot
  Unchanged
  Gap
  Unavailable
  Unsupported
  Invalid
  pub const ALL: [Self; 6]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: &str
  pub const CALLER_UNAVAILABLE: &str
  pub const IDENTITY_REQUIRED: &str
  pub const WRONG_USER: &str
  pub const INVALID_REVISION: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 11]
pub const READER_ERROR_CODES: [&str; 4]
pub const EDITOR_ERROR_CODES: [&str; 5]
pub struct RunOverrides
  nas_store: String
  store: String
  log_sink: String
  log_service: String
pub struct Origin
  rung: String
  path: String
pub struct Origins
  nas_store: Origin
  store: Origin
  log_sink: Origin
  log_service: Origin
  off: Origin
pub struct Snapshot
  nas_store: String
  store: String
  log_sink: String
  log_service: String
  off: BTreeMap<String, String>
  origins: Origins
  stamp: String
pub struct UserSettings
  nas_store: String
  store: String
  log_sink: String
  log_service: String
  off: BTreeMap<String, String>
pub struct UserSnapshot
  values: UserSettings
  revision: String
pub struct UserReplaceResult
  outcome: UserReplaceOutcome
  snapshot: UserSnapshot
pub struct ConfigObservation
  outcome: ConfigObservationOutcome
  cursor: String
  snapshot: Option<Snapshot>
pub fn encode(v: &Snapshot) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Snapshot, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait ConfigReader
  type Error
  fn read(&self, overrides: RunOverrides) -> Result<Snapshot, Self::Error>
pub struct ConfigReaderClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait ConfigEditor
  type Error
  fn read_user(&self) -> Result<UserSnapshot, Self::Error>
  fn replace_user(&self, expected_revision: String, values: UserSettings) -> Result<UserReplaceResult, Self::Error>
pub struct ConfigEditorClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait ConfigObserver
  type Error
  fn observe(&self, overrides: RunOverrides, cursor: String, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<ConfigObservation, Self::Error>
pub struct ConfigObserverClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
